name: tdd
description: Drive implementation through observable RED/GREEN cycles at agreed public seams.
adaptations: Keep tests at pre-agreed stable/public seams and use the repository's existing integration patterns.
Inline the linked upstream tests.md and mocking.md methodology into the remote runtime so dependency loads remain self-contained.
Mock only true system boundaries and reject implementation-coupled, side-channel, and tautological tests.
Require observed execution before claiming RED, GREEN, or any passing verification result.
Keep large refactoring out of the RED/GREEN loop and defer it to the committed review phase.
